hero.title: AI that reads your factory's records and tells you what needs attention today.
hero.sub: ARQ builds software for Indian manufacturers and MSMEs. It works from the Tally data and shop-floor records you already have, and it answers in English, Hindi, Marathi or Gujarati.

proof: Reminders are drafts. You press send.

products.heading: Products
products.sub: Start with the one that fixes today's problem.
products.trialNote: We set up your trial with you on WhatsApp or a call.

astra.oneLine: Connects to TallyPrime and shows who owes you, what stock is stuck and which MSME payments are due. Ask questions in your own language.

yantra.oneLine: Register every machine, log breakdowns by voice and see what maintenance is due. Works in Indian languages.

digitalTwin.tagline: One live picture of the whole plant.
digitalTwin.oneLine: Machines, material and money in one view. In development.

dineastra.tagline: The daily numbers of a restaurant or hotel.
dineastra.oneLine: Planned. If you run a restaurant or hotel, tell us what you need and we will tell you honestly where we are.

dravya.tagline: Keep your supplier GST credit safe.
dravya.oneLine: Matches your purchases against GSTR-2B so you see which supplier credits are at risk before you claim them. In development.

steps.title: Tell us what you run
steps.text: Message us on WhatsApp. We will tell you honestly which product fits, or that none does.

steps.title: Try it for 14 days
steps.text: ARQ Astra and ARQ Yantra have a free 14-day trial.

steps.title: Decide with your own data
steps.text: See your own numbers before you pay. Pricing is quoted on enquiry.

customApps.heading: Need something we do not sell yet?
customApps.text: We build small, focused apps for one process in your factory. We agree one journey, show a working demo on sample data first, then build it.
